typography.heading_h1: font-['Marcellus_SC'] text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

layout_and_navigation.public_site_header: Sticky navbar with dark navy backdrop-blur (bg-[#001524]/90 backdrop-blur-md), containing Sparkle logo, navigation links (Home, Serviços, Sobre, Contato), and 'Acessar Sparkle OS' CTA button.
layout_and_navigation.app_sidebar: Fixed sidebar on dark navy background (#001524) with border-r border-[#003459], module switching for Dashboard, Clientes, Serviços, Contratos, Financeiro, CRM, Tarefas, Portal do Cliente, Usuários.
layout_and_navigation.header_overlay_rule: NEVER use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or floating menus. Always set a solid or blur-backed background (e.g. bg-[#002138] border border-[#003459] shadow-xl).

modules_guidelines.dashboard: KPI cards with monthly revenue, active clients, open leads, pending tasks, accounts receivable/payable, accompanied by revenue vs expense charts and quick actions.
modules_guidelines.clientes: Data table with search, status filters (Ativo, Inativo, Em prospecção), add/edit modals, and detailed client file view with attachment uploads.
modules_guidelines.servicos: Catalog cards showcasing agency packages (Performance, Branding, Social Media, Full Service) with pricing and deliverable tags.
modules_guidelines.contratos: List and status tracker for client contracts with PDF preview/download, values, start/end dates, and renewal status.
modules_guidelines.financeiro: Tabbed view for Contas a Receber, Contas a Pagar, and Cash Flow (Fluxo de Caixa) chart with status badges (Pago, Pendente, Atrasado).
modules_guidelines.crm: Interactive Kanban pipeline with stages (Novo Lead, Qualificação, Proposta, Negociação, Fechado/Ganho, Perdido) and lead modal.
modules_guidelines.tarefas: Kanban & list board for creative production (Briefing, Em Criação, Revisão Interna, Aprovação Cliente, Concluído).
modules_guidelines.portal_do_cliente: Dedicated client view with branded header, project timeline, task approval buttons (Aprovar / Solicitar Alteração), files, and invoice history.
modules_guidelines.usuarios: User management with roles (Admin, Gerente de Conta, Criativo, Cliente) and permission toggles.
modules_guidelines.site_institucional: High-conversion public landing page featuring Hero with star badge, Services breakdown, Case studies, About us section, and a Contact form that directly creates CRM leads.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: MUST include data-testid attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, selects, modals, tabs) in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='crm-add-lead-button').
testing_and_accessibility.toast_notification: Use sonner for user feedback toasts.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all text, labels, messages, buttons, and placeholders are in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
Use primary color #EB7300 for active CTAs and high-priority action buttons.
Maintain contrast compliance: use light text on #001524 navy backgrounds and dark text on light elements.
Provide clear micro-interactions, hover states, and smooth motion using Framer Motion.
Ensure interactive modals and dropdowns have explicit opaque background colors to prevent transparent bleeding.
All interactive elements MUST feature data-testid attributes.
